Cross-validate a regionalization at the stations

Source: R/regionalize-cv.R
ef_regionalize_cv.Rd

Out-of-fold predictions at the stations for one variable and method (dev/specs/gwr-forcing.md section 8.2): for every target time and fold, the method is fitted with the stations of the other folds and predicted at the stations of the fold, with their own covariates and coordinates. Inputs, QC policy and exclusions are those of ef_regionalize(), so the same call with another method gives paired predictions over the same folds (configurations C1, C2 and C3 of dev/VALIDATION_PLAN.md section 2.2).

Usage

ef_regionalize_cv(
  data,
  variable,
  covariates,
  method,
  folds,
  use_qc,
  surface_covariates,
  reselect_bandwidth = TRUE,
  grid = NULL,
  exclude = NULL,
  station_covariates = NULL
)

Arguments

data

The regionalization input: a data frame with the columns station_id, lon, lat (decimal degrees, WGS84), target_time (POSIXct UTC), variable, value (unit of the contract), qc_status ("ok", "warning", "excluded") and, optionally, elevation [m], period_seconds and reference (required for etr_inst and etr_24), as in dev/specs/weather-forcing.md section 7.2; or the result of ef_station_qc() for a variable observed at the stations.

variable

Character, one of "air_temperature" (degC), "vapour_pressure" (kPa), "wind_speed_2m" (m s-1), "clearness" (-), "solar_radiation" (W m-2), "etr_inst" (mm h-1), "etr_24" (mm d-1).

covariates

NULL or a SpatRaster on the working grid, one named layer per covariate (e.g. elevation [m], distance_to_coast [km]). GWR and the global regression use all its layers; the lapse-rate variant of C1 uses elevation. Cells where any layer is NA are outside the domain for every method (value NA, flag EF_INPUT_NA), so that the surfaces of C1, C2 and C3 cover the same cells.

method

A method object from ef_method_gwr(), ef_method_station(), ef_method_ols() or ef_method_idw(); no default.

folds

The folds of the stations: a whole-number vector named by station (e.g. from ef_spatial_folds()) or a data frame with station_id and fold. Every station used in a fit needs a fold; folds of size one give leave-one-out cross-validation with re-selection.

use_qc

Character, no default: the QC statuses that enter the fits, among "ok" and "warning" ("excluded" never does). Recorded in the provenance.

surface_covariates

Character, no default when the method uses covariates: the covariates derived from the surface state (e.g. "lst", "ndvi"), or character(0) if none. Decision GW-07 is open: using them is allowed only when declared here, and they raise EF_GWR_SURFACE_COVARIATE (dev/specs/gwr-forcing.md section 2.7).

reselect_bandwidth

Logical. TRUE (default of the specification): the GWR bandwidth (method with criterion) or the IDW power (several values) is selected again inside each training set (nested). FALSE: selected once per target time with all the stations and kept fixed in the folds; the CV is then conditional on that selection (optimistic), as recorded in the provenance. Without a selection it has no effect.

grid

NULL or a SpatRaster template of the working grid (geometry only); required when covariates is NULL, and with the same geometry otherwise.

exclude

NULL or a data frame with columns station_id and reason: stations excluded by the user.

station_covariates

NULL or a data frame with station_id and the covariates used, to take the covariates at the stations from a table (e.g. elevation of the metadata) instead of extracting them from the rasters (dev/specs/gwr-forcing.md section 2.2, GW-10).

Value

An object of class c("earthflux_regionalization_cv", "list") with:

  • predictions: long data frame with one row per target time and station used: station_id, fold, variable, target_time, observed, predicted, residual (observed - predicted), method, status ("ok", "failed": the fold could not be fitted, with reason; or "representative_station": C1 does not evaluate its own station), reason, n_train (stations of the training set), tuning (GWR bandwidth [m or neighbours] or IDW power used in the fold; NA otherwise) and flag_word (flag word of the prediction at the station, bits of ef_regionalize());

  • folds: data frame station_id, fold;

  • station_table: stations used and excluded per target time, with the reason;

  • variable, method, method_settings, reselect_bandwidth;

  • flags, provenance (selection rule, folds rule, QC policy, number of folds and of failed folds, execution plan, versions, flags_evaluated). as.data.frame() returns predictions.

Details

Failed folds (e.g. too few training stations for GWR, earthflux_gwr_insufficient_stations, or no feasible bandwidth) are reported in predictions with status = "failed" and the condition in reason; they are never dropped silently. The metrics (RMSE, MAE, bias) are computed by the validation module from this table.

Parallel processing

The (target time, fold) tasks are evaluated with future.apply::future_lapply() when the user has set a future plan with more than one worker, and with lapply() otherwise; the result is identical. EarthFlux never sets a plan.

See also

Other spatial regionalization functions: ef_gwr_bandwidth(), ef_gwr_diagnostics(), ef_gwr_fit(), ef_gwr_predict(), ef_gwr_search(), ef_method_gwr(), ef_method_idw(), ef_method_ols(), ef_method_station(), ef_predict_control(), ef_regionalize(), ef_spatial_folds()

Examples

# \donttest{
grid <- terra::rast(nrows = 20, ncols = 20, xmin = 300000, xmax = 320000,
                    ymin = 6100000, ymax = 6120000, crs = "EPSG:32719")
xy <- terra::crds(grid)
terra::values(grid) <- 200 + 0.02 * (xy[, 1] - 300000)
names(grid) <- "elevation"
sx <- 300500 + 1000 * c(1, 4, 8, 12, 17, 2, 6, 10, 15, 18, 5, 13)
sy <- 6100500 + 1000 * c(2, 15, 6, 11, 3, 9, 18, 1, 16, 8, 12, 5)
ll <- terra::project(cbind(sx, sy), from = "EPSG:32719", to = "EPSG:4326")
z <- 200 + 0.02 * (sx - 300000)
data <- data.frame(
  station_id = sprintf("S%02d", 1:12), lon = ll[, 1], lat = ll[, 2],
  target_time = as.POSIXct("2024-01-15 14:30", tz = "UTC"),
  variable = "air_temperature",
  value = 25 - 0.0065 * z + c(0.2, -0.1, 0.3, 0, -0.2, 0.1, 0, -0.3,
                              0.2, 0.1, -0.1, 0),
  qc_status = "ok"
)
folds <- ef_spatial_folds(data.frame(station_id = data$station_id,
                                     x = sx, y = sy), block_size = 10000)
cv <- ef_regionalize_cv(data, "air_temperature", covariates = grid,
                        method = ef_method_ols(), folds = folds,
                        use_qc = "ok", surface_covariates = character(0))
head(as.data.frame(cv))
